articles.company_name: British American Tobacco Industries p.l.c. Common Stock
articles.summary: BAT today announced plans to open a new Information, Digital and Technology (IDT) hub in the heart of Fraser Town, Bengaluru, further strengthening the company’s global technology footprint, and supporting its transformation into a more agile, data-driven business.
articles.title: BAT accelerates technology transformation with new Bengaluru Hub

articles.company_name: British American Tobacco Industries p.l.c. Common Stock
articles.summary: BAT has launched an initiative across Europe aimed at engaging adult consumers and retail partners about the European Commission’s Call for Evidence on EU tobacco and nicotine legislation. Better regulation depends on practical insight.
articles.title: BAT launches initiative to encourage participation of consumers and retail partners in EU’s Call for Evidence
